001-empty.json.note: No agents, no tools, no limits: a fresh install before anything is seen.

002-one-working-shell.json.note: One Claude CLI resident working with the shell activity.

003-starting.json.note: A new session in state starting.

004-working-no-activity.json.note: Working with no activity known (activity is optional).

005-needs-you-permission.json.note: needs_you with reason permission and attention counted.

007-your-turn.json.note: A finished turn waiting for the next prompt.

008-error.json.note: An agent in the error state.

009-limited-with-reset.json.note: limited with a known reset time.

010-limited-unknown-reset.json.note: limited with the reset time unknown (limited_until omitted).

012-unknown-inferred.json.note: A stale agent shown as unknown with inferred confidence.

030-subagent-helper.json.note: A subagent helper linked to its parent.

031-two-sessions-same-tool.json.note: Two concurrent Codex sessions with ordinals 1 and 2.

032-project-label-opt-in.json.note: Project label present because the user opted in.

033-project-label-unicode-spaces.json.note: Project label with spaces and non-ASCII letters.

034-project-label-max-length.json.note: Project label at the 128 character maximum.

035-demo-mode.json.note: A demo-mode snapshot (Demo sign shown, no OS notifications).

036-tools-every-hook-state.json.note: One connector per hook state, offline and present.

037-all-four-limits.json.note: Both providers with both windows, one stale.

038-coverage-reason-hooks-missing.json.note: A connector whose coverage is not verified, because hooks_missing.

039-coverage-reason-hooks-pending-review.note: A connector whose coverage is not verified, because hooks_pending_review.

040-coverage-reason-round-trip-pending.j.note: A connector whose coverage is not verified, because round_trip_pending.

041-coverage-reason-round-trip-failed.js.note: A connector whose coverage is not verified, because round_trip_failed.

042-coverage-reason-receiver-unreachable.note: A connector whose coverage is not verified, because receiver_unreachable.

043-coverage-reason-bare-session.json.note: A connector whose coverage is not verified, because bare_session.

044-coverage-reason-no-permission-event..note: A connector whose coverage is not verified, because no_permission_event.

045-coverage-reason-experimental-adapter.note: A connector whose coverage is not verified, because experimental_adapter.

046-coverage-reason-remote-session.json.note: A connector whose coverage is not verified, because remote_session.

047-coverage-reason-os-unsupported.json.note: A connector whose coverage is not verified, because os_unsupported.

048-coverage-reason-other.json.note: A connector whose coverage is not verified, because other.

049-two-roots-same-tool.json.note: Two Claude connectors (two data roots), each with its own coverage.

050-limits-per-account.json.note: Two Claude accounts keep separate 5h limits; they are never merged.

051-limits-unknown-account-per-root.json.note: Unknown accounts are kept per root.

052-identity-all-null.json.note: Account, session and turn unknown (for example a process seen before its first hook).

053-needs-you-with-request.json.note: needs_you keyed by its request id.

054-needs-you-restored-inferred.json.note: A needs_you restored after a restart is shown as inferred until confirmed.

055-max-tools-and-limits.json.note: 16 connectors and 16 limit entries, the maxima.

056-two-waiting.json.note: Two agents waiting; attention counts both and names the oldest.

059-timestamps-at-bounds.json.note: Timestamps at the legal minimum and maximum.

001-root-array.json.note: The root must be an object.

002-root-null.json.note: The root must be an object.

003-schema-version-1.json.note: schema_version must be 2 (Relay v1 is not accepted).

006-t-in-seconds.json.note: t in seconds is below the ms range.

007-t-string.json.note: t must be an integer, not an ISO string.

010-agent-id-raw-uuid.json.note: A raw UUID is not a salted 32-hex id.

012-agent-leaked-prompt.json.note: A content field such as prompt is rejected as unknown.

013-agent-tool-unknown.json.note: tool must be one of the known tools.

014-agent-host-unknown.json.note: host must be one of the known hosts.

017-state-waiting-v1.json.note: Relay v1 state waiting is split into needs_you and your_turn.

018-state-finished-v1.json.note: finished is a Moment, not a state.

019-state-offline.json.note: offline is per tool, not an agent state.

021-reason-on-working.json.note: reason is only allowed with needs_you.

022-activity-on-idle.json.note: activity is only allowed while working.

023-activity-unknown.json.note: activity must be a known value.

024-limited-until-on-working.json.note: limited_until is only allowed with limited.

025-reason-null.json.note: Optional fields are omitted, never null.

026-parent-missing.json.note: parent is required (null when there is none).

027-project-label-slash.json.note: A project label is a last folder segment, never a path.

029-project-label-empty.json.note: An empty project label is rejected.

030-project-label-too-long.json.note: A project label over 128 characters is rejected.

033-duplicate-tool-ordinal.json.note: The pair tool and ordinal is unique.

034-duplicate-tool-status.json.note: One tools entry per tool and root.

036-hooks-connected.json.note: hooks uses the four defined states.

037-duplicate-limit-window.json.note: One limits entry per provider, window, account and root.

038-duplicate-limit-null-account.json.note: Two unknown-account entries for the same root collide.

044-agent-request-missing.json.note: request_id is required (null when there is none).

045-agent-session-raw-uuid.json.note: session_id is a salted hash, never a raw id.

046-request-on-working.json.note: request_id is only set while waiting on the user.

047-tool-root-missing.json.note: A connector names its data root.

049-coverage-unknown.json.note: coverage is verified, degraded or unsupported.

050-verified-with-reason.json.note: A verified connector has no reason.

053-limit-account-missing.json.note: A limit names its account (null when unknown).

054-limit-root-missing.json.note: A limit names the root of its newest sample.

056-limit-provider-gemini.json.note: Only claude and codex report limits in v0.1.

061-attention-zero-with-time.json.note: oldest_since must be null when nobody is waiting.

062-attention-one-without-time.json.note: oldest_since must be set when someone is waiting.
